card.text: M36 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,125 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_1960: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 1124.82093002 pc (16th to 84th percentile 1123 to 1127)
Wikipedia, "Messier 36"
sources.quote: Messier 36 or M36, also known as NGC 1960 or the Pinwheel Cluster, is an open cluster of stars in the somewhat northern Auriga constellation.

introduction.text: M36 is drawn as 217 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
